source.limits: Computed from a public elevation model, not measured on the ground. Highest and lowest are the model's values at the sample points, with anything below sea level shown as 0. Ascent and descent depend on the smoothing and the threshold, and published figures for the same trail can differ from them by 15 percent or more. Parts of the track are never joined, so a gap is not counted.
source.model: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen terrarium), open data on AWS
source.smoothing: Moving average over 90 m of track; ascent and descent counted with a 5 m reversal threshold
